title: Local Smith Profiles of Twisted Calabi--Yau Algebras
summary: The matrix Hilbert series of a locally finite elementary twisted Calabi--Yau algebra is the inverse of a matrix polynomial. The Smith normal form of this polynomial over the power series ring at $x=1$ produces a finite list of local exponents refining the Gelfand--Kirillov dimension, which records only the largest of them.
